obligations.expected_behavior: When a detached positive Probe executes, it runs as a real independent process.
forbidden_result: The positive Probe executes only in-process or as a simulated process.
obligations.observable_result: Execution evidence shows the detached positive Probe ran in its own process boundary.
obligations.state_after: The detached positive Probe has executed as an independent process.
obligations.state_before: A detached positive Probe is ready to execute.
obligations.subject: Detached positive Probe process execution
obligations.trigger: Detached positive Probe execution is requested.

obligations.expected_behavior: When a detached positive Probe executes, its inputs and outputs are bound to the execution.
forbidden_result: The positive Probe runs with unbound inputs.
The positive Probe produces outputs that are not bound to the execution result.
obligations.observable_result: The detached positive Probe receives bound inputs and its outputs are bound and observable.
obligations.state_after: The detached positive Probe execution has bound inputs and outputs.
obligations.state_before: The detached positive Probe has not yet established bound execution inputs and outputs.
obligations.subject: Detached positive Probe input/output binding
obligations.trigger: Detached positive Probe execution is requested.
